title: "pvj_DataViz"
format: html

```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
lastfm_data <- read_csv("/Users/elizapalmer/Documents/GitHub/ds212-portfolio-epalmer-dev/pvj/rawData/lastfm_data_updated.csv")
```
#Sorting through data to decide what to make a visualization of

```{r}
lastfm_data %>%
  count(Artist, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
music_2025_byMonth <- lastfm_data %>%
  filter(str_detect(Date, "2025")) %>%
  mutate(Date = dmy_hm(Date)) %>%
  mutate(month_name = month(Date, label = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(month_name) %>%
  summarize(total_scrobbles = n())
```

```{r}
music_2025_byMonth %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = month_name, y = total_scrobbles, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
music_2025_byArtist <- lastfm_data %>%
  filter(str_detect(Date, "2025")) %>%
  count(Artist, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
music_2025_byArtist %>%
  filter(n > 180) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = Artist)) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
top_artist <- lastfm_data %>%
  filter(str_detect(Date, "2025")) %>%
  count(Artist, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Artist)
```

```{r}
artist_monthly <- lastfm_data %>%
  filter(str_detect(Date, "2025")) %>%
  filter(Artist %in% top_artist) %>%
  mutate(
    Date = dmy_hm(Date),
    month_name = month(Date, label = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  count(Artist, month_name, name = "scrobbles")
```

```{r}
artist_monthly %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = month_name, y = reorder(Artist, scrobbles, FUN = sum), group = Artist)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(size = scrobbles, color = scrobbles))
```

```{r}
ggplot(artist_monthly, aes(x = month_name, y = Artist, fill = scrobbles)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", direction = -1) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      family = "sans",      
      face = "bold",         
      size = 16,            
      hjust = 0.5            
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2025 Monthly Listening Heatmap by Top 10 Artists",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    fill = "Number of Listens",
    caption = "Author: Eliza Palmer | Date: November 2026 | Data: Last.fm"
  )
```

```{r}
artist_monthly_binned <- artist_monthly %>%
  mutate(
    listen_cat = cut(
      scrobbles,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 25, 50, 75, Inf),
      labels = c("0–25", "26–50", "51–75", "76–100+")
    )
  )


ggplot(artist_monthly_binned, aes(x = month_name, y = Artist, fill = listen_cat)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "BuPu") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(
      family = "sans",      
      face = "bold",         
      size = 16,            
      hjust = 0            
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      family = "sans",      
      size = 8,            
      hjust = 0         
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      color = "darkgrey",
      size = 8,
      hjust = 0
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "My Top 10 Artists by Month in 2025",
    subtitle = "Noah Kahan was consistently a top artist, while Gracie Abrams dominated the spring and Renee Rapp dominated the fall",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    fill = "Number of Listens",
    caption = "Author: Eliza Palmer | Date: November 2026 | Data: Last.fm"
  )
```
